tagline: A Joseon-dynasty capital of palaces and hanok rooftops, wired together by a spotless subway and markets that never seem to close.

events.name: Lotus Lantern Festival
events.desc: Thousands of handmade lanterns parade through Jongno to Jogyesa ahead of Buddha's Birthday.

events.name: Jongmyo Daeje
events.desc: The royal ancestral rite, with ritual court music and dance, performed at Jongmyo Shrine.

events.name: Seoul International Fireworks Festival
events.desc: A huge evening display over the Han River at Yeouido, a short subway ride from downtown.

events.name: Seoul Lantern Festival
events.desc: Illuminated lantern sculptures line the Cheonggyecheon stream through the heart of the CBD.
